app.title: TACAI Prj - Japan HR Finance System
app.subtitle: SAP-style payroll profiles, multi-country payroll calculation, payroll register, payslips, and audit logs
dashboard.title: Payroll Operations Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Payroll operations are kept in TACAI-PRJ while employee master data and user administration are managed by their source systems.
payroll.input_desc: Input is manual-first. HR can type directly, use salary profiles, or import one Excel payslip/payroll row to fill this form. June 2026 JP/SG/CN payroll lists remain pending until Employee Master is completed.
payroll.manual_desc: Use EmployeeAdmin employee number/name. Salary Profiles are payroll-specific references only; local Employee Master maintenance has been removed from this payroll system.
payroll.excel_desc: Use this when HR already has a payroll Excel or one Japan/Singapore/China template file. One upload imports one employee record into the manual form for confirmation.
payroll.preview_desc: These values are recalculated from the manual form. Confirming will save the record into Payroll Register.
payroll.step_parse: The system parses one record and fills the form.
payroll.step_check: HR checks, edits, or clears fields.
payroll.step_confirm: Confirm saves it into Payroll Register.
register.title: Payroll Register
register.saved_note: Saved payroll records from local payroll database.
register.sample_note: No confirmed records yet; showing sample payroll data.
payslips.title: Payslips
payslips.desc: MVP preview of payslip values generated from Payroll Register records.
payslips.empty: No payslip records are available yet.
audit.title: Audit Logs
audit.desc: Read-only audit logs for payroll profile, calculation preview, upload validation, export, and void actions. Audit records must not be edited or deleted.
integration.user_source: User accounts and permissions are maintained in the main Portal/User_admin.
integration.employee_source: Employee master data is maintained in EmployeeAdmin.
integration.employeeadmin_available: EmployeeAdmin source is connected. {count} employee(s) are available as read-only lookup hints.
integration.employeeadmin_unavailable: EmployeeAdmin is unavailable or not authenticated. Manual employee number/name input remains available; do not create a local employee master here.
message.default_progress: Step 1: enter payroll manually or import one Excel file. Step 2: check the form. Step 3: confirm and save.
message.sample_loaded: Sample payroll Excel loaded into the manual form. Please check, edit, then confirm.
message.excel_imported: Excel imported into the manual form: {filename}.
message.only_first_record: Only the first record was loaded because this screen imports one employee at a time. Please check, edit, then confirm.
message.manual_calculated: Manual payroll input calculated. Please check the result, then confirm.
message.saved_success: Saved successfully. The record is now available in Payroll Register and Payslips.
error.upload_required: Please upload a payroll Excel file.
error.no_excel_record: No payroll record could be parsed from this Excel file.
error.required_identity: Employee No., Employee Name, and Payroll Month are required.
salary_profiles.title: Salary Profiles
salary_profiles.desc: Create lightweight payroll salary profiles for Japan, China, Singapore, and India-remote employees. Employee master data remains in EmployeeAdmin; these profiles are payroll-specific references only.
salary_profiles.empty: No salary profiles have been created yet.
payroll.profile_desc: Select a payroll-specific salary profile and enter monthly attendance inputs. This profile is not Employee Master. Tax estimates remain reference-only until HR confirms.
message.profile_payroll_calculated: Profile-based payroll calculated. Please check the result, then confirm.
message.mid_month_termination_note: Employee terminates during this payroll month. Attendance inputs must exclude days after the termination date.
error.required_profile_fields: Employee No., Employee Name, Entity, and Payroll Scheme are required.
error.invalid_payroll_month: Payroll month must use YYYY-MM format.
error.after_termination: Payroll cannot be calculated after the employee termination date.
error.working_days_required: Monthly working days must be greater than zero.
tax_reference.title: Tax Reference / HR Confirmation
tax_reference.disclaimer: Reference estimate only. HR must confirm before payroll close. Estimated values do not affect net pay unless HR confirms or applies them.
tax_reference.hr_confirm_required: Tax reference estimate requires HR review and confirmation.
tax_reference.missing_jp_table: Japan withholding table is not configured. HR must enter or confirm income tax manually.
tax_reference.jp_table_no_match: No matching Japan withholding table row was found; HR must confirm manually.
tax_reference.cn_cumulative_note: China IIT uses cumulative annual withholding; prior YTD values are needed for accurate estimates.
tax_reference.missing_cn_ytd: Prior YTD income is missing for a cumulative month after month 1; estimate may be incomplete.
action.apply_tax_reference: Use estimate as income tax deduction
field.cn_prior_ytd_special_additional_de: CN Prior YTD Special Additional Deductions
report.all.title: Payroll Summary - All Countries
report.cn.title: China Payroll Report - Standard Draft
report.jp.title: 給与台帳 - 日本
report.sg.title: Singapore Payroll Report
report.template_note: The table uses the selected country report template. CSV exports are Excel-compatible; native xlsx/PDF is a later phase.
payroll.employee_master_dependency_title: June JP/SG/CN payroll list pending Employee Master
payroll.employee_master_dependency_desc: Japan, Singapore, and China June payroll employee lists will be finalized after EmployeeAdmin master data is established. Do not create fake local employees in TACAI-PRJ; use Salary Profiles only for payroll-specific rates and references.
payroll.country_template_status: Japan and Singapore templates are treated as confirmed. China has a standardized draft template and requires business review before final use.
payroll.csv_excel_note: Current exports are Excel-compatible UTF-8 CSV. Native .xlsx and PDF exports remain later-phase work unless dependencies are approved.
payroll_rules.title: Payroll Rule Master
payroll_rules.desc: Maintain auditable payroll calculation rules. Operators select supported calculation types and parameters instead of writing free-form formulas.
payroll_rules.empty: No payroll rules have been created yet.
salary_profiles.employee_select_placehol: Select from EmployeeAdmin, or leave blank for manual entry
error.required_rule_fields: Rule code, rule name, and calculation type are required.
error.duplicate_active_rule: An active payroll rule with the same code and overlapping effective dates already exists.
error.duplicate_active_profile: This employee already has an active salary profile for the same effective period.
error.standard_hours_required: Standard monthly hours must be greater than zero.
salary_profiles.edit_desc: Editing the current profile is audited. For salary changes or employment-type changes, create a new version instead.
salary_profiles.new_version_desc: Creating a new version ends the old version on the day before the new effective date and preserves audit history.
salary_profiles.eligible_employee_count: EmployeeAdmin employees eligible for a new salary profile: {count}. Filters: active, payroll-ready, and no active salary profile yet.
payroll_rules.edit_desc: Rule changes are written to audit logs. Closed payroll records should not be retroactively affected by new rules.
salary_profiles.deactivate_desc: This does not delete historical data. The profile will no longer be available for new payroll calculations. Existing payroll records and audit logs remain unchanged.
salary_profiles.deactivate_confirm: I understand this salary profile will be removed from active payroll use.
salary_profiles.inactive_notice: This salary profile is inactive and cannot be used for new payroll calculations.
error.inactive_profile_not_allowed: Only active salary profiles can be used for new payroll calculations.
payroll_cockpit.title: Payroll Cockpit
payroll_cockpit.desc: Monthly payroll close workbench for batch creation, generation, checks, confirmation, payslips, and future distribution.
payroll_cockpit.validation_errors_desc: Blocking issues found across active batches
payroll_cockpit.empty: No payroll batches yet. Create a batch to start monthly close.
payroll_batch.detail_desc: Batch-level control page. Phase 1 stores the monthly batch and prepares generation, validation, confirmation, and locking actions.
payroll_batch.records_desc: Active payroll records linked to this batch
payroll_batch.phase1_hint: Phase 1 completed the batch foundation. Generate, validate, confirm, and lock buttons are prepared for the next implementation slices and are intentionally disabled for now.
payroll_batch.no_records: No payroll records are linked to this batch yet.
salary_profiles.history_notice: You are viewing history. Inactive or voided salary profiles are retained for traceability and audit only; they are not used for new payroll calculations.
salary_profiles.non_active_notice: This salary profile is not active and is retained only for history and audit.
salary_profiles.void_desc: Use this only when the salary profile was created in error from the beginning. The record is not physically deleted, but it is marked voided and excluded from normal operations and new payroll calculations.
salary_profiles.void_confirm: I confirm this salary profile was created in error and should be voided.
salary_profiles.voided_notice: This salary profile has been voided and cannot be used for new payroll calculations. It remains available for audit only.
error.void_confirm_required: Please confirm voiding this salary profile.
payroll_batch.control_hint: Generate payroll from active Salary Profiles, run checks, then confirm and lock before payslip PDF generation.
payroll_batch.control_hint_locked: This batch is locked. Normal regeneration and void operations are blocked.
message.batch_validated: Payroll batch checks completed: {errors} error(s), {warnings} warning(s).
message.payslip_queued: Payslip queued for email distribution to {email}.
error.batch_generation_not_allowed: This payroll batch cannot be regenerated in its current status.
error.no_profiles_for_batch: No active Salary Profiles match this batch.
error.duplicate_confirmed_employee_month: Another confirmed or locked batch already has an active record for the same employee and month.
error.batch_validation_not_allowed: This payroll batch cannot be checked in its current status.
error.batch_confirm_not_allowed: Batch must pass validation before confirmation.
error.batch_lock_not_allowed: Only confirmed batches can be locked.
error.payslip_generation_not_allowed: Payslips can only be generated after payroll confirmation.
error.no_records_for_payslips: No payroll records are available for payslip generation.
error.employee_email_required: Employee email is required before queuing payslip email.
error.pdf_required_for_email: Payslip PDF must be generated before email distribution.
validation.batch_has_no_records: Batch has no generated payroll records.
validation.missing_employee_id: Generated payroll record is missing EmployeeAdmin employee_id.
validation.duplicate_employee_month_in_b: Duplicate employee/month exists in this batch.
validation.duplicate_confirmed_employee_: Another confirmed/locked batch already contains this employee/month.
validation.employee_not_found: Employee was not found in EmployeeAdmin.
validation.missing_employee_email: Employee email is missing; payslip email distribution will be blocked.
validation.tax_reference_requires_review: Tax reference is estimated and requires HR review.
error.delivery_not_found: Payslip email delivery was not found.
error.delivery_not_sendable: This payslip email delivery cannot be sent in its current status.
error.payslip_already_sent: Payslip email has already been sent.
payslips.email_send_note: Email sending uses the configured HR sender. Salary amounts are not written in the email body; the generated PDF is attached.
payslip_email.subject: Your payslip for {month}
payslip_email.body:
Dear {employee_name},

Your payslip for {month} is attached as a PDF.

This email and attachment contain confidential personal information. Please do not forward or share it with unauthorized parties.

If you have questions, please contact HR/Payroll.

TAC HR Admin
